proposal.blind_spot: For the sub-saturated (DRAM 68-85%) failing kernels the optimizer cannot tell whether weak latency hiding is caused by register-capped occupancy or by shared-memory reduction latency, so it cannot predict which rewrites will collapse occupancy or add pointless shared-memory staging.

rationale.launch__registers_per_thread: HIGH -> occupancy is register-capped: shrink BLOCK/num_stages, avoid wide per-thread vectorized tiles or cap registers to raise resident warps / LOW -> registers are not the constraint: fix occupancy via num_warps/grid shape and per-thread rewrites are safe
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_short_scoreboar: HIGH -> shared-memory reduction latency is a real secondary bottleneck: use warp-shuffle reductions, split reductions for ILP, or pad shared arrays / LOW -> shared-memory path is irrelevant: treat as pure streaming and do not add shared-memory tiling/staging
